name: Health Indicator
description: Shows how much health nearby players and mobs have left.

name: Hit Range
description: Draws a ring around a player to show their attack range.

name: Shield Status
description: Changes a shield's color as the player raises it, blocks with it, or waits for it to recover.

name: Fullbright
description: Brightens dark areas using Gamma or Night Vision.

name: Fly Speed
description: Lets players adjust their flight speed when flying is already allowed.

name: Freelook
description: Lets players look around without turning their character.

name: Stretched Res
description: Stretches the world horizontally while keeping the HUD at its normal size.
